priorityList.notes: Judgement on cooldown: it is a free global that unloads the seal's judgement effect and starts its ten second cooldown again.

Exorcism on cooldown vs Undead and Demons (paladin.md audit finding 3): implemented, learnable at 20, 15s cooldown, real Holy nuke -- sim/paladin/exorcism.go's ExtraCastCondition already gates it on target.MobType == Demon || Undead, and sim/core/spell.go routes ExtraCastCondition through Spell.CanCast, so spellCanCast naturally no-ops on any other target with no new APL condition type needed. Free damage on the right encounters; the smoke build's default target is not Undead or Demon, so this cannot be proven to fire against it -- proven structurally instead (the action survives the rank rewrite at 60 and 20, spellCanCast resolves with no validation warning).
Hammer of Wrath below 20 percent: the execute-window button Retribution has besides seals, Judgement and Holy Strike.

Holy Strike on cooldown: new in Forever this week (sim/paladin/holy_strike.go, no engine file before it) -- an instant Holy weapon attack on its own 10s cooldown, learnable from level 6. Judgement and seal maintenance alone leave GCDs idle every ten-second window; Holy Strike is the filler that spends them. Measured directly: adding it (with the seal twist removed, see notes) raised a level-60 band-60-BiS forever-sim run from 165.6 to 190.0 DPS.

Reapply Seal of Righteousness once it is about to expire -- this is now the ONLY seal-maintenance line (see notes for why the seal twist that used to sit here was removed). It also catches the seal being deactivated by Judgement's own cast (sim/paladin/judgement.go's castSpecificJudgement), which fires this same condition on the very next decision.
